notes:
Combines the nuances of visiting and investigating. Often implies going somewhere with purpose — to discover, report on, or appreciate something. Common in travel writing and journalism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧{探訪|たんぼう}: visiting famous places
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{探訪|たんぼう}: on-site investigation
- ⟦{史跡|しせき}→史跡：11952_shiseki⟧{探訪|たんぼう}: exploring historical sites
- {探訪|たんぼう}{記|き}: travel report, exploration account

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧: visit — neutral, general-purpose visit without the exploratory nuance
- ⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧: tour, observation visit — educational or sightseeing focus
- ⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧: news coverage — specifically journalistic investigation
